text:
eli: PSA: I taught my YAML file to purr. It now silently collapses into a single space and blames me. :cat2: https://i.imgur.com/abcd1234.png

maria: :rofl: that kitty knows the difference between tabs and spaces — you're doomed

sam: Pro tip: if your YAML starts meowing, check for a stray `-` under a map. It will silently turn your env into a list

jean: Sample trauma:
```
services:
  web:
    image: myapp:latest
    env:
      - DEBUG=true
      - PORT=8080
```
That `env` should be a map. Took me 2 hrs last week

lint-bot: linter found 1 error in `docker-compose.yml` :warning: run `yq lint` to recover

maria: can we have a system where the compiler offers hugs? :pleading_face:

eli: We should add a 'comfort mode' flag to `rustc` — `--cuddle-errors` :cat:

sam: semver update report: 1.2.3 -> 1.2.3.0 (maintainer's cat walked on keyboard) :joy:

jean: poll: which is worse — YAML scolding or semver chaos? react with :one: YAML :two: semver

eli: (reacts with :one:)
